test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He congratulated me _______ my success.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**on**" is used to indicate the subject or focus of the congratulation.
 
• In this context, the congratulation is related to "**my success**," making "**on**" the most appropriate choice.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He congratulated me **on**__ my success."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "of"** is incorrect because "congratulate" is not followed by "of" in standard English.
 
• **Option 2: "off"** is incorrect as it does not convey the intended meaning in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "at"** is incorrect because "at" does not fit grammatically with "congratulate."
